decisions.reason: As a flagship cloud service prominently shown on the home page and tightly aligned with the firm's strategic push into scalable multichannel business messaging, it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
Its own product page and referenced customer adoption suggest credible market traction, and document capture fits the firm's move toward end-to-end digital document workflows.
Although less prominent and partly tied to transitional fax-email use cases, it still supports the firm's multichannel integration proposition for regulated customers.
This looks like a narrow optimization feature in a more legacy fax segment, so management would likely fold resources back into core platforms or newer growth products.
Email threat protection is a strong adjacency to secure enterprise messaging, and security capabilities are strategically important for the firm's customer base and positioning.
